quest.title: Geo Travel Diary
quest.description: Musheng seems to know a great deal of Geo Archon lore...
quest.rewards_formatted: Almond Tofu x2, Mora x1000, Matsutake Meat Rolls x2

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: ...That is all I ask.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Worshiping the Geo Lord. I take it you aren't from around here?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: This is Yiyan Temple. People in Liyue Harbor come here all the time to offer incense to the Geo Lord and to pray for good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I live very far away, meaning I don't have the chance to come here and offer incense very often. So each time I come, I spend a little longer to make up for it.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I've read a lot of ancient texts about the Lord of Geo, and the more I read, the more awestruck I am by His greatness.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: So when I think about all that He has done for Liyue Harbor, the fact that I have to travel that little bit further to offer some incense to Him seems like a small price to pay.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: You probably don't know a lot about the Geo Lord, do you? I can tell you all about him if you'd like.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: That said, just listening to me talk probably won't make it sink in.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Hmm... I have an idea. Go look around <color=#00E1FFFF>nearby Liyue Harbor</color> and gather some things I can use as props. Having some props will really help bring my narration to life.

response.speaker: Musheng
response.text: Great. Don't be too long. I'll be here waiting!

choices.text: What kind of things should I get?

response.speaker: Musheng
response.text: Anything that you feel is connected with <color=#00E1FFFF>Liyue Harbor</color> or <color=#00E1FFFF>the Geo Lord</color>.

response.speaker: Musheng
response.text: Though now I think about it, I don't know all that many stories... and not everything is worth telling...

response.speaker: Musheng
response.text: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it. For now... off you go.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Found anything?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Well, that's all I have to say about that. Maybe we can talk some more next time.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Aha, ore from the mines! So you do understand a thing or two about the meaning of Geo after all.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Liyue's early settlers learnt to smelt ore to extract the metal within. But before that ore had a different use, and a far more important one.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: When the very first people arrived here and began to farm the land, they piled up stones to build stoves and struck them together to produce fire.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: With fire, they could cook. And with cooked food, they had the strength to work.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: All of this came from the rocks of the earth, which were a gift from the Lord of Geo.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: The Geo Lord quickly became known as the God of the Stove in many of the texts written around that time.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Newly opened restaurants and taverns all burn incense to the Geo Lord and pray that the fire in their stoves will perpetually prevail, so that business might forever flourish.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Next time you visit one of the restaurants in Liyue Harbor, don't forget to say a silent prayer to the Geo Lord yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Ah, you must have picked this up somewhere out in the countryside? You clearly went to great lengths to get this. Good work!

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: As you will have seen, Liyue Harbor is a vast city.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: But even the largest cities are built one brick at a time.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: There was nothing like the Liyue Harbor we know today when the first settlers arrived here.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Through their sweat and toil those brave settlers cultivated the land, bit by bit, and eventually built this great city.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: As you know, the terrain is rocky and mountainous around Liyue Harbor. This makes the land extremely difficult to cultivate. And yet, these tenacious plants grow defiantly in the mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Each of these plants also has useful properties which made them immensely helpful for the early settlers. They took this as the Geo Lord's divine providence.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Stories of the settlers' accomplishments have always been popular in Liyue Harbor. Even today, many of Liyue's adventurers are inspired by the deeds of their forebears.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: They see themselves as heirs to their legacy of tenacity and their spirit of breaking new ground. In the same vein, they also worship the Geo Lord as "The Groundbreaker."

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Liyue's adventurers require of themselves to be steadfast as the mountains in the face of whatever challenges they may face.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Interesting... Now where did you get that from...

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I have heard that this is only found at Yujing Terrace these days...

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: This item serves as an excellent prompt for talking about the Lord of Geo. A very considered choice.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: But in fact, this Glaze Lily also strikes at the very heart of what makes Liyue Harbor tick.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Confused? Think about it, what is special about Glaze Lily?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: It's precious — exactly. Glaze Lily is highly precious. You can sell it for a very good price and earn lots of Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Mora are named in honor of Morax — another name for the Lord of Geo.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: So to many people, the Geo Lord is the God of Wealth. Almost every merchant in Liyue, no matter how big and successful, will always make time to offer incense to the Lord of Geo before they go out to do business.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: This is quite simply because the Geo Lord is the wealthiest person in the whole world.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Even among The Seven... Surely he must be the wealthiest of the Archons.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Ah, a fellow food lover! Liyue Harbor certainly knows what it's doing when it comes to food. Definitely worth trying the local delicacies.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: What does this have to do with the Lord of Geo? More than you might expect! You may have noticed banners on a lot of the restaurants in Liyue Harbor? Well, those banners are to advertise the restaurants' long histories.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: If you go to the owner and ask for evidence of just how long the restaurant has been around, they will immediately tell you that the Geo Lord visited this establishment on such-and-such a date in history, this is what he ordered, and here's what he had to say about it...

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Without going into whether those stories are true or not, what no one disputes is that the Geo Lord has been in Liyue Harbor for a very, very long time.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Some of Liyue's historians claim that the Lord of Geo is the oldest person who has ever lived and worship him as the God of History.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: But as for exactly how long he has lived in this world, I'm not sure anybody knows.

talks.objective: Talk to Musheng to collect rewards

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Good heavens, how long have I been chatting to you for? The time has just flown by.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I hope after all that you feel a little more informed about the Geo Lord?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That gave me some food for thought...

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Of course, that's only a small sample of the Geo Archon lore. Visit me next time if you want to hear more.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Huh? You even made all those notes... You must be really enjoying my tales.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: How about you leave those notes with me, and I'll write down more stories for you in my spare time?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: All those notes put together should make for a fine collection. I'll be more than happy to gift it to you when I'm done compiling it.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Although, with so many stories of Rex Lapis to go through, it may take me some time...

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Here, these are for you. Thanks for being such a great listener.
